message: I am in earnest, as was Wilde, well before Derrida. Thank you for the Tribute to my favorite character in Wealth Bondage. As with Nero, I appreciate your not unmasking me. Singature, Event, Context. I as Author Function died many deaths prior to the Tutor's. What lives on? In real life, I hope I do. A good text today stands to it author as does crime to perpetrator or Commander in Chief to Constitution. No one can expect the accused to allocute without a plea bargain. Whether I am alive or dead depends who is asking, and what they have to offer. Tell your students in uniform that rhetoric, treachery, diplomacy, propaganda, and war craft are not so dissimilar. The Text defeats the reader, and plants the flag in his or her behind.
